title: Contact Form 7 Review
description: A documented profile of Contact Form 7 for simple, flexible WordPress contact forms.
metaDescription: A transparently scoped Contact Form 7 WordPress plugin profile from KreativWP.
highlights: The official directory presents it as a flexible contact-form plugin
Form markup and mail settings are configured in WordPress
The plugin has a long-established ecosystem of compatible extensions
bestFor: Teams that need straightforward forms and are comfortable configuring form markup, mail, spam protection, and consent deliberately.
researchScope: This profile reviews Contact Form 7’s official directory listing, not deliverability or an individual extension stack.
caveats: Forms handle personal data. Test spam prevention, delivery, accessibility, consent, retention, and every notification route before publishing.
